apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Leaving the app no longer pauses the session (iOS's media pause on the way out is ignored).
Toe yoga moves into Barefoot PT (after doming); the Boot-on PT button is gone. An evening start more than 4 h after the morning always gets a full round.
